evidenceInspected: SP-B4-1 re-tested on a snapshot of ea1b310 with the round-1 scratch specs: with the erase's deletes uploaded and with them held, 'refusals after erase+refuse: 0' and no student data kept; both specs now fail only on their own assertion that a leak exists
The SP-B4-1 fix: uploadRefusals.ts keep rule (a delete always; an insert or edit only when its course is on the device) and parentsPresent requiring the course row itself
SP-B4-2: an edit whose row is on the device goes as a whole-row upsert limited to the schema's columns; a PATCH remains only for a row no longer on the device

Live cross-account matrix with the two synthetic accounts: the other account's whole-row upserts of the course, an existing student and a new student all 403/42501; the owner's student unchanged; bare PATCH and DELETE still 204 with 0 rows, but the app no longer sends a bare PATCH for a row on the device and a DELETE carries no personal data; 0 rows left
No personal data in client console output during the runs
